plain_text:
The Governor's Emergency Education Relief (GEER) Annual Performance Report (APR) is
collected using the Education Stabilization Fund (ESF) Data Collection Tool. The ESF Data
Collection Tool is a web-based application that allows Governors' offices to report information
that constitutes the APR for GEER grantees.
semantic_text: The Governor's Emergency Education Relief (GEER) Annual Performance Report (APR) is collected using the Education Stabilization Fund (ESF) Data Collection Tool. The ESF Data Collection Tool is a web-based application that allows Governors' offices to report information that constitutes the APR for GEER grantees.

plain_text:
This document is intended to guide users in submitting the GEER APR. This document is also
intended for Outlying Area users in submitting the Education Stabilization Fund Program –
Governors (ESF-Governor) APR.

plain_text:
The U.S. Department of Education awarded GEER grant funds to State Governors' Offices
through two different programs, CARES (GEER I) and CRRSA (GEER II) – ALN 84.425C and ESF-
Governor – ALN 84.425H. States determined how to disseminate funds within their state to
best meet the needs of students, schools, postsecondary institutions, and other educational
organizations affected by COVID-19.
